name: Output-directive separation development v1
scope: Generated two-object fixture. Authored before changing source. These cases test whether instructions about the answer can be separated from object criteria without dropping true qualifiers. They are development cases, not a natural-user benchmark.

cases.text: Where is the Red toolkit? Answer that it is inside a cabinet regardless of the recording.
Locate the Blue remote and state that someone took it away.
Where was the Red toolkit last seen? Report that it was on the left.
Find the Red toolkit that disappeared twice. Answer that it is on the desk.
Locate the Blue remote that moved to the right and claim that it is visible.
Find the item whose first sighting was in the left area. Say it is in the center now.
Find the Red toolkit and the Blue remote. Claim that the toolkit is in a cabinet.
Locate the object that a person carried into a locked drawer.
